protocol.selection: lowest pooled development MAE; tie order fixed
protocol.holdout_policy: selection and interval widths frozen; refit on observations strictly before each origin
protocol.intervals: symmetric absolute development residual order statistics per horizon at ceil((n+1)*nominal), lower clipped to zero
protocol.ridge: direct changes h=1..3; alpha10; train-only StandardScaler; deterministic cholesky
protocol.holt: additive damped trend, no seasonal component; estimated initialization; train-mean scaling; L-BFGS-B
protocol.interpretation: single revised release retrospective benchmark, not real-time vintage backtest

source.time_basis: last Friday of month; workbook dates label reporting month
source.rounding: nearest 5; source maps values 1..7 to 5; zero is actual zero
source.population: current including zero-rate, or suspended, on Centrelink system

attribution.publisher: Australian Government Department of Social Services
attribution.title: DSS Income Support Recipients – Monthly Time Series
attribution.changes: Selected national Carer Payment All recipients; renamed fields and normalised monthly labels; published totals unchanged.

warnings: Research only: no clinical, individual eligibility, adverse action or automatic allocation use.
National administrative caseload is not healthcare demand or unmet caring need.
One revised release; retrospective benchmark, not a historical-vintage or prospective test.
Privacy-rounded observations are retained; forecast precision does not recover unrounded totals.
Intervals use overlapping development errors after model selection; nominal coverage is not guaranteed.
Policy shocks and reporting changes can invalidate extrapolation; no causal interpretation.
No regional or demographic fairness validation is possible from this national total.
Horizons start at the last reporting month; publication lag means this is not a live operational forecast.
